claim: Documentation, no theorem. Lists every statement that the knot's spaces compose only through hubs, or that a 3-edge cut's sides are exactly equality and not-all-equal (KNOT-COMPOSE-20261101-001: proof A's title, Theorem 4(1) and 4(3), proof, novelty, manifest, result, check docstring and ticket texts; reading B and its ticket; the decision note, closure ledger, epic ticket and discovery record D001; SELECTION-NOTE-20261101-001: abstract item (5), Section 6 title, Theorem 12, review package, proof, manifest, result and ticket; three knot-intuition passages) and marks each withdrawn, corrected or standing, with the replacing evidence (NATIVE-PATHS-20261101-001A); 36 quoted locations confirmed by records_check.py, and no other tracked file states the withdrawn claim. The complementarity lemma, balance, double cuts, the transpose, hub-free failure as parity and the native-network verdict stand; the note needs an erratum before any sharing; superseding D001's status is left to the owner, following the precedent of commit bb2bed541.
conclusion: 'Compose only through hubs' is withdrawn (2-edge cuts compose by two-place parity, without a hub) and 'exactly equality and not-all-equal' is corrected to hold up to signs; every other statement of the composition epic and of the note stands.
